form.s1Example: Example: the bundle "Coffee + mug" is 1 coffee and 1 mug. The customer sees one line, and both products leave the warehouse.
form.s1Fixed: The composition is fixed: the buyer does not choose components (use separate offers for choice). A change applies to new orders, open orders keep the old composition.
form.s1GiftHelp: A gift is a component the customer does not pay for separately. Turn on "Gift" for it here, and choose its form on the document in step 3.
form.s1KompletNote: In warehouse systems this is the equivalent of a kit (komplet).
form.s1Lead: Add the products the bundle is made of and enter how many of each go into one package. Bundle stock = the lowest component stock (when a bundle holds several pieces: stock ÷ quantity).
form.s2Adopted: A product with this SKU was already in the shop, so we used it.
form.s2CreateCannot: {name} cannot create products from OpenLinker. Pick a product that is already in the shop, or another shop.
form.s2CreateErrorTitle: The shop did not create the product
form.s2CreateFailed: The shop refused to create the product. Check the name, SKU and price.
form.s2CreateFailedGeneric: Could not create the product in the shop. Try again.
form.s2CreateNotSynced: The product was created but has not reached us yet. Try again in a moment.
form.s2CreateUnavailable: {name} is not reachable right now. Try again in a moment.
form.s2CreatedBadge: Product created in the shop: {name} ({sku}). The fields can no longer be changed - save the composition again.
form.s2DescriptionHelp: We suggested a description from the components. Change it if you like.
form.s2DiagramCaption: This step chooses the middle one.
form.s2DiagramLabel: How it connects: components make up the bundle product in the shop, and offers on channels are made from it.
form.s2EanHelp: A bundle does not need an EAN, its components have their own. Enter your own barcode if you have one (some marketplaces may require it).
form.s2EanIsComponent: This EAN belongs to the component "{name}". The bundle should have its own code or none.
form.s2ExistingHelp: You change the name, SKU and price in the shop. OpenLinker picks up the changes by itself.
form.s2ExplainerShow: How does it work? Why a bundle needs a product in the shop
form.s2Images: Add pictures in the shop after the product is created. They appear here after the next sync.
form.s2Lead: A bundle must exist in your stock system or shop, because that is where OpenLinker reads stock from. We create it for you - there is nothing to do by hand.
form.s2Locked: The bundle product is already set and does not change when you edit the composition.
form.s2MasterCannot: This shop does not let OpenLinker create products.
form.s2MasterHelp: The stock system or shop where the bundle will exist as an item and where we read its data from.
form.s2Mode: Where does the bundle product come from?
form.s2ModeExistingText: Pick an item that already works as a bundle there. Its name, SKU and price stay as they are; we only add the composition.
form.s2ModeNewDisabled: None of your shops lets OpenLinker create products.
form.s2ModeNewText: OpenLinker creates a plain item there with the name, SKU and price you enter below. Recommended if you do not have one yet.
form.s2NameHelp: This is the name in the stock system; you set the Allegro offer title when you list it. A good name says it is a bundle and how many pieces it holds, e.g. "Mug + coaster, set of 2".
form.s2NoMasters: None of your shops lets OpenLinker create products. Pick a bundle you already have in your shop, or add another shop.
form.s2NoShops: You have no shop connected yet, so there is nowhere to create the bundle product.
form.s2NothingYet: Nothing is created in the shop until you save the bundle in step 4.
form.s2PriceFixed: The price is fixed: it does not change when a component's price changes.
form.s2PriceMore: The bundle costs {amount} more than the components separately.
form.s2PriceNoSum: A component has no price, so we do not suggest a sum.
form.s2PriceSaves: The customer pays {amount} less than for the components separately.
form.s2PriceSuggestHelp: We suggest the sum of the components. Enter a lower price to give a discount.
form.s2SearchEmpty: No results for “{query}”. We search by name and SKU.
form.s2SearchEmptyAction: Not in the shop? Create a new bundle product
form.s2SearchHint: Type at least 2 characters: a product name or SKU.

form.s2TargetsFailed: We could not check which shop can create the product.
form.s2Why: Why in the stock system? That is where you keep the name, SKU, price and pictures. We read them from there, and offers on marketplaces are built from this item.
form.s3DocHeld: Unknown rate: the document waits for your decision.
form.s3DocText: When all components have the same VAT rate, the bundle is one line at the bundle price. When the rates differ, the document shows the components separately and the price is split proportionally. If a rate cannot be determined we do not guess: the document is held.
form.s3DocTitle: How the bundle looks on a document
form.s3Form: How the gift looks on a document
form.s3GiftLine: In stock: {stock} · price on its own: {price}
form.s3InheritText: The form from the sales documents settings, the same for every gift.
form.s3Lead: What to know about a gift in a bundle:
form.s3None: No component is a gift, so there is nothing to set here. You can continue, or mark a gift in the components.
form.s3NoneDetails: How it looks on a document
form.s3NoneLead: No gift - nothing to set. The invoice will have one line: {name} (with different VAT rates: components separately).
form.s3NoneStock: The bundle has no stock of its own - we work it out from the components.
form.s3Preview: This is how the gift would look on the document:
form.s3Rule1: The gift travels in the parcel at the bundle price: the customer does not pay for it separately.
form.s3Rule2: It comes off your stock and counts towards your cost.
form.s3Rule3: The form on the document only changes how the gift looks on the invoice or receipt, not the price or the stock.
form.s3WhoCustomerNote: One line at the bundle price (with different VAT rates: components separately).
form.s3WhoPlain: You do not assemble the bundle: there is no assembly and no stock of its own. Stock stays on the components, and OpenLinker works out from it how many bundles you can sell.
form.s3WhoWarehouseNote: We pack and ship the components.
form.s4CannotAssemble: This bundle cannot be assembled right now: one component is short on stock. You can save it, but the offer will show stock 0 until the components arrive.
form.s4DiscountMore: Components total {sum}, bundle price {price}: the bundle costs {more} more than the components separately.
form.s4DiscountSame: Components total {sum}, bundle price {price}: no discount.
form.s4DocumentsNoGift: The bundle on a document: one line or its components, depending on VAT rates.
form.s4HappensCreate: A new bundle product “{name}” is created in the shop {master}.
form.s4HappensCreateNoMaster: A new bundle product “{name}” is created in the shop.
form.s4HappensExisting: The composition is added to the product “{name}” in the shop. Its name and price stay as they are.
form.s4HappensNoStock: Saving does not change any stock. When the bundle sells, the components' stock goes down and the picker gets the components to pack.
form.s4HappensNotListed: The offer is not created on save: the button that lists it appears right after saving.
form.s4HappensPlain: This is an ordinary product with no components, not a kit. The bundle composition stays in OpenLinker, which splits the components when it sells.
form.s4HappensSave: OpenLinker saves the composition and the gift marks.
form.s4Lead: Check what will be saved. Saving does not list an offer - the button to list it appears right after you save.
form.s4Next: What next: after saving, click "List on {name}". It is a separate, final step.
form.s4NextMany: What next: after saving you choose where to list the offer. It is a separate, final step.
form.s4OrderBody: The order shows one bundle line; the warehouse takes the components out of stock.

new.i2t: 1. Components and quantities. 2. The bundle product with a fixed price. 3. Gifts and how they appear on the document. 4. Review, save and send to the channels.
